New York, NY: your single partner for cleaning, delivery, security, and warehouse robots fitted to your building.

Commercial robots give your New York operation a direct answer to labor shortages, handling essential cleaning, delivery, and security work reliably. An autonomous scrubber can keep your floors spotless overnight, while a delivery robot runs supplies between floors without complaint. We deploy and service these units right here, making it simple for any business to get started.

The real value is consistency. These machines handle the repetitive material handling in a warehouse or the late-night floor care in a retail space with the same precision every time. This frees your team for the work that requires a human touch, all through a single monthly plan that includes full maintenance and support.

Cleaning robots in New York City

New York City carries roughly 124,000 hotel rooms across the five boroughs and more than two hundred licensed hospitals and inpatient facilities citywide — two of the densest hospitality and healthcare markets in the country. Every one of those buildings runs a hard-floor cleaning operation, usually overnight, on a crew that's expensive and hard to keep fully staffed in this labor market.

A commercial cleaning robot is built for exactly that grind: it maps a hotel lobby, a hospital corridor, or a big retail floor once, then runs the same route every night on schedule — covering the repetitive open ground so a smaller crew can focus on the detail work a machine can't do.

Service Robot Co. is the integrator for that in New York — we pick the right scrubber or sweeper OEM-neutrally, finance it, deploy and map the floor, and keep it serviced through a nationwide engineer network. One vendor for the whole deployment, not a machine and a manual.

How it works in New York

From walkthrough to working robot.

One partner runs the whole job for your New York operation — you approve the plan, we handle the rest and keep it running.

1
We walk your site

A free site assessment — floor plan, surfaces, obstacles, and the labor you want to hand off. No throughput promises before we see the floor.

2
We match the unit

We shortlist the 2–3 chosen-manufacturer robots that fit the work — matched to the floor, not the brochure — and confirm the model with you.

3
You pick the terms

Buy it, finance it, or rent it monthly. Your CFO picks the structure; we surface the options up front, with no single-price trap.

4
We deploy & integrate

We install on your floor, map the space, and connect the robot to the systems you already run — a working machine, not a project.

5
We train your team

Your staff learn the daily handling in an afternoon. Routines, scheduling, and dashboards are set up before we leave.

6
We keep it running

10-minute remote triage in business hours, 24-hour on-site dispatch, and a backup unit on hand. One in three issues never needs a truck.

One partner for the whole deployment in New York

One partner runs the whole job for your New York operation: we pick the right unit across OEMs, finance it buy-or-monthly, deploy it, integrate it, train your staff, and service it through a US engineer network.
